descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S01 Toggle In Today on and off for several residents; only the tapped resident changes, and an un-marked resident keeps their chart

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 All Residents is the baseline list of everyone the physician follows at the facility, and every resident in it has a working 'In Today' / '+ Today' toggle. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 1; TFA-92587 How it works 1)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fixture resident (In Today) plus QA Ash (Maple 1, In Today), QA Ashby (Maple 2, In Today, with a vital BP 128/76, a medication row 'Donepezil 10 mg nightly' and an Important Point 'QA point: daughter visits Fridays') and QA Cove (Maple 3, not In Today); one Hospital patient

When All Residents → un-mark QA Ashby → mark QA Cove → Today's Visits → All Residents → open QA Ashby's chart (Pre-Round) → back → All Residents → mark QA Ashby → un-mark QA Cove → Today's Visits

Then Every resident in All Residents has a toggle. After the first round Today's Visits lists QA Ash, QA Cove and the fixture resident, not QA Ashby; QA Ashby is still in All Residents with '+ Today' and their chart still shows the vital, the medication and the Important Point. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint (UAT step 4 'toggle on and off for several residents'): each resident is checked by name on each Today's Visits checkpoint with mustContain / mustNotContain (U5); Today's Visits checkpoints mustNotContain 'In Today ✓' and All Residents checkpoints mustContain it, to prove the tab; …

Where it ran: dev unit U13; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
